purpose: Separate teacher-learning sufficiency, rollout truncation, scorer behavior, and student-baseline quality before another OPD launch.
claim_boundary: This plan authorizes read-only audits and setup-only length calibration. It does not reopen the failed M teacher, rewrite sealed scores, authorize teacher retraining, or authorize OPD student training.

immutable_history.O_teacher_result: retain the post-hoc symbolic-eligible score-ledger result and its caveat
immutable_history.predecessor_student_runs: retain as pilots; do not relabel absolute held-out accuracy as improvement
immutable_history.score_recovery: never heuristically score an incomplete capped trajectory

length_calibration.selection_surface: first 64 records of roles/O/student_opd.jsonl under the existing deterministic task order; this is setup/training data, never teacher_gap_dev or source_holdout
length_calibration.prompt_contract: existing concise reasoning plus final answer inside boxed braces
length_calibration.staging_rule: Run 2048 and 4096 first. Run 8192 only for a model family that has no qualifying smaller cap.

selection_rule.student: smallest candidate passing every criterion for the raw student
selection_rule.teacher: smallest candidate passing every criterion for both raw and merged O teachers

length_calibration.failure_rule: If 8192 fails, stop. Register and test a new compact prompt on fresh setup-only records; do not extract answers from truncated text and do not touch final evaluation roles.
length_calibration.scientific_use: The chosen student cap must be shared by raw, task-RL, offline-distillation, and OPD student arms. The chosen teacher cap must be shared by paired raw/trained teacher evaluation.

teacher_recipe_successor_requirements.training_reward: Use one registered reward/status contract for teacher optimization and evaluation, or predeclare and report their disagreement matrix before training.
teacher_recipe_successor_requirements.training_length: Use the qualified teacher completion cap; truncated completions remain masked and separately counted.
teacher_recipe_successor_requirements.group_signal: Increase generations per prompt or use a preregistered outcome-independent difficulty sampler; full DAPO must not be claimed unless dynamic sampling and the remaining DAPO recipe are implemented.
teacher_recipe_successor_requirements.checkpointing: Save periodic checkpoints and optimizer state. Select duration on a frozen tune-dev subset that is disjoint from teacher_gap_dev and every student/external evaluation role.
teacher_recipe_successor_requirements.final_gate: Run the complete teacher_gap_dev paired evaluation once after recipe and checkpoint selection. Preserve symbolic-eligible and excluded-semantic populations separately.
teacher_recipe_successor_requirements.replication: After one recipe-qualification seed, freeze the recipe and use seeds 0, 1, and 2 for any paper-level teacher-training claim.

required_arms.meaning: student task-reward training with the same rollout and optimizer budget as OPD
fixed teacher demonstrations or logits; distinguishes on-policy data collection from ordinary distillation
on-policy teacher likelihood only; collapse diagnostic, not the preferred method
task reward plus teacher signal under the registered gate

student_baseline_contract.pairing: Every trained arm shares initialization, seed, exact prompt order, optimizer-step budget, rollout cap, evaluation records, and evaluation seeds within a replicate.
student_baseline_contract.primary_measurement: paired completion reward on held-out records; also report pass@k, parseability, cap rate, calls, tokens, latency, and verifier unknowns
student_baseline_contract.forbidden_inference: An absolute trained-model accuracy, finite loss, checkpoint, or one-step diagnostic is not student improvement.

exposure_reporting.policy: Report only documented dataset membership as known exposure. Dataset age, model-card benchmarks, and temporal feasibility are risk indicators, not proof of item-level training exposure.
exposure_reporting.black_box_probe_boundary: Memorization and completion-prefix probes may be reported as diagnostics but cannot verify private pretraining membership.
